'''Whatever's glowing''' was a drink served at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. At five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] a glass, the beverage was expensive, much like the other drinks at the [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]].<ref name="WHoSaV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Whatever's glowing was first mentioned in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a [[1997]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Paul Danner]].<ref name="WHoSaV" />
